title: 第九章 人王九秘第十章 谎言
content_zh:
“这……”女讲师大气不敢喘，被半步丹心盯着，她压力无比巨大。
其余几位讲师也不敢再出声。
“几位都在呀。”
正当气氛压抑之际，楚天舒走了进来。
“楚天舒，你竟然敢走过来？”那女讲师向楚天舒施压道，“抢夺同族生灵石，你可知罪！”
“那咋了？”楚天舒不以为然道，“有事找我爹娘去，别在这里和我嚷嚷。”
沃德法！
这小子太嚣张了！仗着自己爹娘是丹心，就目中无人。
楚穆问道：“你如今已与他们结下了恩怨，日后就不怕……”
“有事找我爹娘。”楚天舒重复道。
楚穆一时语塞，找不到合适的语句来反驳：“玛德，这小子怎么连自己人都怼？要不是有我袒护，他早就被拿下了！”
一旁几位讲师都看傻眼了，纷纷石化：人不能……至少不应该……这么没有底线……
“拿来。”楚天舒伸出手。
“什么？”楚穆懵了。
“我的那份生灵石。”楚天舒淡淡道。
好家伙，原来是想起来自己还有一份生灵石没有拿呀！
楚穆：“……”
女讲师：“……”
其他几位讲师：“……”
楚穆强忍着一巴掌扇死楚天舒的冲动，拿出四块生灵石：“你小子可真有种啊！”

“有事找我爹娘。”楚天舒将四块生灵石收入囊中后，转头就走。
两步之后，他突然停下脚步：“对了，学堂以后我不会来了……有事找我爹娘。”
待楚天舒走出大门后，学堂才爆发出灵力轰鸣声。
楚穆肺都气炸了：“艹！特么的，那小兔崽子……”
……
家主府，某处房间内。
“哇！少爷你哪来这么多生灵石呀！”青儿双眼直冒光。
楚天舒取出五块递给青儿。
“啊？给我的？”青儿拒绝道，“这太贵重了，少爷还是自己用吧，不然……半年以后怎么打得过那楚玥。”
这几日，青儿确实听到了无数“风言风语”，那时她才知道自家“少爷”到底做了什么。
“我走的路子与大多数人不同，主要是炼体，这生灵石只起辅助作用。给你，你就拿着。”楚天舒道。
“不要。”青儿将五块生灵石又递了回去。
“拿着吧。”楚天舒道。
“不要。”青儿态度依旧决绝。
“这丫头挺倔强的。”楚天舒心想道。
……
content_en:
"This..." The female lecturer was so angry that she didn't dare to breathe. Being stared at by half-step Danxin, she was extremely stressed.
The other lecturers did not dare to speak out anymore.
"Everyone is here."
Just when the atmosphere was depressing, Chu Tianshu walked in.
"Chu Tianshu, how dare you come over here?" The female lecturer put pressure on Chu Tianshu, "Do you know your sin for robbing the soul stone of a fellow creature?"
"What's going on?" Chu Tianshu said disapprovingly, "If you have anything to do, go to my parents and don't yell with me here."
Ward's Law!
This guy is so arrogant! Relying on the loyalty of his parents, he became arrogant.
Chu Mu asked: "Now that you have established a grudge with them, you will not be afraid in the future..."
"If you have any questions, please contact my parents." Chu Tianshu repeated.
Chu Mu was at a loss for words and couldn't find the right words to retort: "Made, how come this kid can even fight against his own people? If it weren't for my protection, he would have been captured long ago!"
Several lecturers on the side were dumbfounded and turned to stone one after another: People can't... at least they shouldn't... be so bottomless...
"Bring it here." Chu Tianshu stretched out his hand.
"What?" Chu Mu was confused.
"My share of the living stone." Chu Tianshu said calmly.
Good guy, it turns out that I remembered that I still had a life stone that I didn’t take!
Chu Mu: "..."
Female lecturer: "..."
Several other lecturers: "..."
Chu Mu resisted the urge to slap Chu Tianshu to death, and took out four living stones: "You are really smart!"
"If you have anything to do with me, please see my parents." Chu Tianshu put the four living stones into his bag, turned around and left.
After two steps, he suddenly stopped: "By the way, I won't come to the school anymore... If you have any questions, please see my parents."
After Chu Tianshu walked out of the door, the school erupted with a roar of spiritual power.
Chu Mu was furious: "Fuck! Damn it, that little bastard..."
…
The head of the house, in a room somewhere.
"Wow! Master, where did you get so many living stones!" Qing'er's eyes gleamed.
Chu Tianshu took out five yuan and handed it to Qing'er.
"Ah? For me?" Qing'er refused, "It's too expensive. Young Master should use it himself, otherwise... how will he be able to defeat Chu Yue in half a year?"
In the past few days, Qing'er had indeed heard countless "rumours", and only then did she know what her "young master" had done.
"The path I take is different from most people. It's mainly about body training. This living stone only plays a supporting role. Here you go, take it." Chu Tianshu said.
"No." Qing'er handed back the five living stones.
"Take it." Chu Tianshu said.
"No." Qing'er's attitude remained decisive.
"This girl is quite stubborn." Chu Tianshu thought to himself.
…
